periods.time: Award ceremony after the Seven Stars final
periods.label: 参加颁奖典礼的绫辻绚濑

status.current: attends Ikki's award ceremony using Kuraudo's guest ticket

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Benefactor whose ceremony she wants to witness.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Accompanies him and uses his related-ticket access.

periods.summary: Ayase appears among Ikki's acquaintances at the award ceremony, having come at least to see her benefactor receive the championship honor. She stands with Kuraudo and cheers/congratulates Ikki while Kuraudo acts outwardly sullen.

periods.time: During and just after Japan's special conscription
periods.label: 以天衣无缝逮捕越狱犯
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Ayatsuji dojo; temporarily special conscription forces

status.current: confident enough to fight escaped Blazers and later observe Kuraudo's duel with Moroboshi
status.condition: shows growth from Ikki's sword correction and Kaito's training

relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Father and teacher; he orders her to capture Okuma as practical training.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Troublesome fellow disciple under Kaito; she worries and scolds him but recognizes his strength.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former short-term sword instructor whose body-use corrections still support her growth.
relationships.toka-todo: Senior who praises her bravery during special conscription.

periods.summary: Ayase faces escaped prisoner Ginji Okuma when he attacks the Ayatsuji dojo seeking revenge on Kaito. She inherits Ayatsuji Ittou-ryuu's counterattacking basis but has grown beyond mere imitation of Kaito thanks to Ikki's corrections. After defending against Okuma's wind-enhanced rushes, she uses the奥义 Ten'i Muhou and her Device Hidzume's wound-expansion ability to bring him down. Later she attends the special conscription debrief and watches Kuraudo duel Moroboshi, explaining that Kuraudo is a true genius of violence despite her resentment toward him.

key_events.summary: Captures the escaped prisoner attacking her family dojo.
Observes and interprets Kuraudo's final growth against Moroboshi.

periods.label: 连接藏人的联络人

status.current: called to Tokyo defense but relays Moroboshi's request for Kuraudo to go to Kyushu
status.condition: anxious but prepared for war conditions

relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Kuraudo is staying at/connected to the Ayatsuji dojo; Moroboshi teases her as his woman, which she angrily denies.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Receives his call asking her to send Kuraudo to Kyushu.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Mentions the capital summons in the broader context of Ikki's peers, though Ikki is absent from the Tokyo scene.

periods.summary: Ayase is in the Ayatsuji dojo preparing for the capital defense summons when Moroboshi calls from Kyushu. He asks whether Kuraudo is with her and tells her to send him to Kyushu instead of the Tokyo front. Ayase protests that eastern Japan's student knights are under emergency summons, but Moroboshi argues that Kuraudo will be more useful in Kyushu and accepts responsibility for the breach. Her brief scene provides the contact route by which Kuraudo becomes the second arrow against Daien.

key_events.summary: Receives Moroboshi's call and becomes the channel for redirecting Kuraudo to Kyushu.

periods.time: Tokyo underground defense and victory night
periods.label: 防卫层与误认小一辉

status.current: survives the underground defense and returns to celebration
status.condition: injured in the defense layer but rescued by reinforcements

relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Father; he unexpectedly fights beside her and saves her from EDY fire.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Rival/complicated ally; his return saves the defense layer and he shows awkward concern for her injury.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Mistakes his child body for an injured boy and drags him to a women's bath, not believing he is Ikki.

periods.summary: Ayase leads frightened low-rank students in the underground defense layer after EDY breaches Tokyo's shelter zone. Her own sword cannot damage EDY armor, but she keeps fighting and is joined by her father Kaito. When she is injured and about to be shot, Kaito kicks her away and Kuraudo arrives to crush the EDY. On victory night Ayase finds miniature Ikki covered in blood, assumes he is a lost child, and takes him to a public bath; because the men's side is full, she unwittingly brings him into the women's side and later does not believe his claim to be the real Ikki.

key_events.summary: Fights EDY in the underground city until Kaito, Kuraudo, Moroboshi and Toka's group turn the battle.
Mistakes child-sized Ikki for a boy and takes him to bathe.
